title.en: Plant growth regulators: characteristics and discovery
title.kn: ಸಸ್ಯ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕಗಳು: ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರ

heading.en: A foolish seedling and a ripe orange

hook.en: Rice seedlings in Japan grew absurdly tall and fell over; ripe oranges stored with green bananas made them ripen fast. Both mysteries led to plant hormones.
hook.kn: ಜಪಾನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭತ್ತದ ಸಸಿಗಳು ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಉದ್ದ ಬೆಳೆದು ಬಿದ್ದವು; ಮಾಗಿದ ಕಿತ್ತಳೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇಟ್ಟ ಹಸಿ ಬಾಳೆಹಣ್ಣು ಬೇಗ ಹಣ್ಣಾಯಿತು. ಈ ಎರಡೂ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಸಸ್ಯ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳ ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿದವು.

objectives.en: Classify PGRs by chemical nature and by action.
Describe the discovery of each of the five PGRs.

narration.en: Rice seedlings in Japan grew absurdly tall and fell over; ripe oranges stored with green bananas made them ripen fast. Both mysteries led to plant hormones.
narration.kn: ಜಪಾನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭತ್ತದ ಸಸಿಗಳು ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಉದ್ದ ಬೆಳೆದು ಬಿದ್ದವು; ಮಾಗಿದ ಕಿತ್ತಳೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇಟ್ಟ ಹಸಿ ಬಾಳೆಹಣ್ಣು ಬೇಗ ಹಣ್ಣಾಯಿತು. ಈ ಎರಡೂ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಸಸ್ಯ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳ ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿದವು.

body.en: Plant growth regulators (PGRs) are small, simple molecules of diverse chemical composition: indole compounds (indole-3-acetic acid, IAA), adenine derivatives (N⁶-furfurylamino purine, kinetin), derivatives of carotenoids (abscisic acid, ABA), terpenes (gibberellic acid, GA₃) or gases (ethylene, C₂H₄). They are also called plant growth substances, plant hormones or phytohormones. By function they fall into two groups: plant growth promoters (auxins, gibberellins and cytokinins), involved in cell division, enlargement, pattern formation, tropic growth, flowering, fruiting and seed formation; and plant growth inhibitors, such as ABA, involved in responses to wounds and stresses, dormancy and abscission. Ethylene could fit either group, but it is largely an inhibitor of growth activities.

points.en: Ethylene: either group, largely an inhibitor.

narration.kn: ಸಸ್ಯ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕಗಳು ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪದ ಸರಳ ಅಣುಗಳು. ಆಕ್ಸಿನ್, ಜಿಬ್ಬರೆಲಿನ್, ಸೈಟೋಕೈನಿನ್ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜಕಗಳು; ಅಬ್ಸಿಸಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲ ಪ್ರತಿಬಂಧಕ; ಇಥಿಲೀನ್ ಎರಡೂ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರಬಹುದು.

narration.en: Let us build a table of who found each plant growth regulator, then sort them into promoters and inhibitors.

say.en: The Darwins saw canary grass coleoptiles bend to light because of something made in the tip. Went later isolated auxin from oat coleoptile tips.
Kurosawa found that the fungus Gibberella fujikuroi causes bakane, foolish seedling disease of rice: the active substance was gibberellic acid. Skoog and Miller identified kinetin.

Abscisic acid was found as three inhibitors that turned out to be the same compound. Cousins found that ripened oranges released a gas, later identified as ethylene, that hastened ripening of bananas.
Auxins, gibberellins and cytokinins mainly promote growth; abscisic acid inhibits it. Ethylene can do either, but is largely an inhibitor.

text.en: Chemically diverse, active in tiny amounts

body.en: Charles Darwin and his son Francis Darwin saw that coleoptiles of canary grass bent towards unilateral light (phototropism); the tip was the site of the transmissible influence. Auxin was isolated by F.W. Went from the tips of coleoptiles of oat seedlings. The "bakane" (foolish seedling) disease of rice is caused by the fungus Gibberella fujikuroi; E. Kurosawa showed that sterile filtrates of the fungus caused the same symptoms in uninfected rice seedlings; the active substance was later identified as gibberellic acid. F. Skoog and co-workers found that tobacco callus proliferated only when the medium had, besides auxin, extracts of vascular tissue, yeast extract, coconut milk or DNA; Skoog and Miller later crystallised the cytokinesis-promoting substance, kinetin. In the mid-1960s three kinds of inhibitors, inhibitor-B, abscission II and dormin, were purified and later found to be chemically identical: abscisic acid. Cousins confirmed that ripened oranges release a volatile substance that hastens the ripening of stored unripe bananas; it was later identified as ethylene.

points.en: Gibberellin: Kurosawa, bakane disease of rice.

problem.en: Match each PGR to its chemical nature: IAA, kinetin, ABA, GA₃, ethylene.

steps.en: IAA is an indole compound; kinetin is an adenine derivative (N⁶-furfurylamino purine).
ABA is a carotenoid derivative; GA₃ is a terpene.

answer.en: IAA – indole; kinetin – adenine derivative; ABA – carotenoid derivative; GA₃ – terpene; ethylene – gas
